decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (L1855/01F, L1855/LPA, Design & Access Statement Received 14/04/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for the operation of a car wash shall not be carried on outside the following times 10.00-22.00 Mon-Sat; 10.00-16.00 Sun & Bank Holidays

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until details of a drainage scheme, indicating how surface water will be captured and intercepted prior to connection to the sewer network, have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall be carried out as approved prior to the commencement of the development.

Condition : 5 - The use of the site for car washing shall only be undertaken using the chemicals and cleaning equipment specified in the Design & Access Statement received 14/04/2011, which shall be maintained and kept in good working order.  No other chemicals or cleaning equipment shall be used without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The use of the site for car washing shall not obstruct the free usage of the car park, and shall only occur within the two designated parking bays as indicated on drawing L1855/01F received 14/04/2011, unless by prior written agreement from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The rating level of noise emitted from the car washing operations at the site, shall not exceed the existing background noise level. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The measurements shall be made according to BS4142:1997.
description: Operation of a hand car wash
